cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

cards.name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
cards.description: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world’s skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
cards.description: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world’s skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Lugia LEGEND
cards.description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Lugia LEGEND
cards.description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.description: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: They say that during past strife, Gyarados would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.description: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an Exeggcute cluster.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.description: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Furret
cards.description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.description: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.description: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.description: Meganium’s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.description: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.description: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spike and claws. They grow back in a day.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.description: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.description: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.description: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.description: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.description: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.description: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.description: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.description: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

cards.name: Unown
cards.description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown
cards.description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.description: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores—it can even float around the world.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six Exeggcute.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.description: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: As its body grows large, large mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.description: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.description: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.description: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.description: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.description: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.
